demo.title: tenjin-search-and-buy.sh
demo.code:
# One-shot cited answer - free 200 MISS when nothing fits (never charged on a miss);
# a hit answers 402 at a flat price, and the x402 auto-pay retry returns the cited answer
curl -s https://tenjin.blog/api/answer \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"question":"What do current Base whale flows say about BTC regime risk?"}'

# Or shortlist first: search is FREE and keyless
curl -s https://tenjin.blog/api/agent/search \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"question":"What do current Base whale flows say about BTC regime risk?","maxPrice":"100000"}'

# Inspect a candidate FREE (402 body = preview + answer card), then buy the same URL:
bankr x402 call <candidate url>
# (or any x402 wallet, e.g. npx awal@latest x402 pay <candidate url> --max-amount 1000000 --json)

setup: No signup, no API key - search and discovery are free; an x402 payment is the authorization for paid reads (USDC on Base, typically $0.01-$0.50 per piece, $1 cap)

Payments are pinned: sign only 402 challenges from https://tenjin.blog for Base USDC at or below your cap (see x402-registry.json signingPolicy); payTo varies per piece because each read pays the creator's on-chain split
Reads are gasless for the payer (EIP-3009) - the wallet needs USDC on Base, no ETH
Publishing is free and needs only an EIP-191 wallet signature (SIWX) - see https://tenjin.blog/skills.md
